content:
**Adorn** 是一個裝飾與家具模組，新增了許多裝飾方塊，例如…… - 椅子與沙發！你可以在上面坐下休息。沙發也是小憩的好地方。 - 抽屜！比箱子更小的容器，卻能作為更精緻的家具。 - 石製火把！由石頭打造，照明效果優於木製火把。 - 廚房方塊！你可以使用廚房檯面、櫥櫃和水槽來裝飾你的廚房（非常適合廚房主題整合包！） - 還有更多：桌子、架子、柵欄、煙囪…… ## 需求 ### Fabric

### NeoForge *無需額外前置。* ### Quilt - [Quilted Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl) ![](https://i.imgur.com/owM5tUa.png) ## 模組相容性 Adorn 針對以下模組提供了特殊支援： 模組 | Fabric 與 Quilt | Forge 與 NeoForge | 功能 -|-|-|- [Architect's Palette][arpal] | ❌ | ✅ | 方塊變體 [Biome Makeover][bmake] | ✅ | ✅ | 方塊變體 [Biomes O' Plenty][bop] | ✅ | ✅ | 方塊變體 [Blockus][blockus] | ✅ | ❌ | 方塊變體 [BYG][byg] | ✅ | ✅ | 方塊變體 [Cinderscapes][cind] | ✅ | ❌ | 方塊變體 [DashLoader][dashl] | ✅ | ❌ | 支援 Adorn 的方塊狀態 [Ecologics][ecol] | ❌ | ✅ | 方塊變體 [EMI][emi] | ✅ | ✅ | 自訂配方功能等 [JEI][jei] | ✅ | ✅ | 自訂配方功能等 [LambDynamicLights][ldl] | ✅ | ❌ | Adorn 方塊動態光源 [Lil Tater Reloaded][ltr] | ✅ | ❌ | 馬鈴薯供電 [Mod Menu][modm] | ✅ | ❌ | 設定介面 [Promenade][promenade] | ✅ | ❌ | 方塊變體 [Roughly Enough Items (REI)][rei] | ✅ | ✅ | 自訂配方功能等 [Tech Reborn][tr] | ✅ | ❌ | 方塊變體 [Terrestria][terr] | ✅ | ❌ | 方塊變體 [Towelette][towel] | ✅ | ❌ | 支援 Adorn 方塊的流體記錄功能 [Traverse][trav] | ✅ | ❌ | 方塊變體 [Woods and Mires][wam] | ✅ | ❌ | 方塊變體 [arpal]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architects-palette [bmake]: https://modrinth.com/mod/biome-makeover [bop]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/biomes-o-plenty [blockus]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/blockus [byg]: https://modrinth.com/mod/biomesyougo [cind]: https://modrinth.com/mod/cinderscapes [dashl]: https://modrinth.com/mod/dashloader [ecol]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ecologics [emi]: https://modrinth.com/mod/emi [jei]: https://modrinth.com/mod/jei [ldl]: https://modrinth.com/mod/lambdynamiclights [ltr]: https://modrinth.com/mod/ltr [modm]: https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu [promenade]: https://modrinth.com/mod/promenade [rei]: https://modrinth.com/mod/roughly-enough-items [tr]: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/techreborn [terr]: https://modrinth.com/mod/terrestria [towel]: https://modrinth.com/mod/towelette [trav]: https://modrinth.com/mod/traverse [wam]: https://modrinth.com/mod/woods-and-mires
